programme.title: Hadsons un Reksis
programme.desc: Inspektors Reksis ir atgriezies! Tikai citā ampluā. Uz populārā austriešu detektīvseriāla motīviem balstītais kanādiešu seriāls būs stāsts par draudzību, cieņu un noziegumiem. Detektīvs Čārlzs Hadsons ir galvenais detektīvs Svētā Džona policijas iecirknī. Viņa partneris ir Reksis, vācu aitas šķirnes suns ar izcilu dzirdi. Hadsons jau kopš bērnības ir vēlējies kļūt par detektīvu. Reksi izglāba nejaušība. Viņu vēlējās iemidzināt pēc tam, kad viņa iepriekšējais "cilvēkpartneris" gāja bojā dienesta laikā. Tomēr Rekša palīdzība ikdienas darbā ir nenovērtējama. Detektīvu komandā darbojas arī superintendants Donovans un IT speciālists Mills. Jaunajā darbā Hadsons nokļuva pēc šķiršanās ar sievu, un visas sezonas gaitā viņu un partneri Reksi sagaida mīklainas slepkavības un, protams... pica un hotdogi. Reksis spēj saost picas piegādātāju pat kilometriem tālu! Galvenās lomas atveidotājs ir kanādiešu aktieris Džons Rīrdons, kurš ir zināms arī kā veiksmīgs futbolists. Jaunībā aktieris vēlējies karjeru medicīnā un ieguvis bakalaura grādu bioloģijā. Filmēties sācis 2000. gadu sākumā, un ir pazīstams arī ar lomu tīņu trillerī "Šausmenīte 4".

programme.title: Alpu dakteris
programme.desc: Nav labākas vietas, kur patverties no pilsētas kņadas, trokšņa un stresa, kā kalni. Bet dzīvot tur? Dzimto Alpu mazpilsētiņu, saucot tās gaisotni par smacējošu un aprobežotu, Mārtins pameta jau pirms daudziem gadiem, lai kļūtu par veiksmīgu ārstu kosmopolītiskajā lielpilsētā Ņujorkā. Nu viņš ir atgriezies. Uz pavisam īsu apciemojumu, lai atkal drīz atvadītos. Taču no likteņa neizbēgsi - atgriešanās mājās izrādās uz palikšanu. Jo pārāk liels ir trieciens, uzzinot, ka viņa pirmā mīlestība, kas pēc Mārtina aizbraukšanas apprecēja viņa paša brāli Hansu, ir mirusi. Taču atstājusi meitu, par kuras esamību Mārtins nekad pat nebija zinājis! Ar to izrādās pietiekami, lai izlemtu palikt Pēkšņi kļuvis par tēvu, Mārtins vēlas uzzināt vairāk par savu jauniegūto meitu Lili, iemantot viņas uzticēšanos. Tā dēļ viņš ir gatavs pat mēģināt sadarboties ar savu jaunāko brāli Hansu, kas joprojām jūt aizvainojumu. Hanss ir kļuvis par glābēju komandas vadītāju, un kopā ar Mārtinu viņi turpmāk neskaitāmas reizes riskēs ar savu dzīvību, lai glābtu kalnu negadījumu upurus vai kāpējus, ko pārsteigusi pēkšņa vētra. Mārtinu gaida atklāsme, ka bez saknēm nav iespējas turpināt dzīvi. Šeit viņš pilnībā aptvers arī to, ka būt par ārstu kalnos - tā nav tikai profesija, bet gan aicinājums. Kļūt par labu neatliekamās medicīniskās palīdzības sniedzēju kalnos iemācīties nevar, par tādu piedzimst. Un Mārtins Grūbers tāds neapšaubāmi ir!

programme.title: Vieglatlētika. Dimanta līga Parīzē
programme.desc: Astotais sezonas posms Parīzē "Charléty" stadionā, un atkal būs pa septiņām Dimanta līgas disciplīnām gan vīriešiem, gan sievietēm. Nu jau būs aizvadīta puse sezonas, nākamais posms būs Jūdžinā ASV, bet jau pēc tam visi atlikušie – tikai un vienīgi Eiropā. Vīriešiem būs sešas skriešanas disciplīnas – 100, 400, 800, 5000 metri, tāpat 110 metru barjerskrējiens un 3000 metru kavēkļu skrējiens. Vēl programmā ir arī kārtslēkšana, kas bieži vien ir kā "saldais ēdiens" sacīkstēs. Sievietēm programma būs daudzpusīgāka. Skrejceļā būs tikai četri veidi – 400, 800, 1500 metru skrējieni, tāpat 100 metri ar barjerām. Parīzē būs arī kārtslēkšana, lodes grūšana un šķēpa mešana. Interese par sacensībām ir ļoti liela, visas biļetes ir izpārdotas. Parīzē solījies ierasties arī pašlaik labākais vieglatlēts pasaulē – kārtslēcējs Armands Duplantiss, kas gan nesen Stokholmā piedzīvoja pirmo zaudējumu sezonā, ja tā var nosaukt otro vietu. 100 metru skrējienā gaidām olimpisko čempionu Noa Lailsu, arī daudzās citās disciplīnās piedalīsies vairākas zvaigznes. Latvijas līdzjutējiem interesanta varētu būt šķēpa mešana sievietēm, pēdējos gados ļoti labi panākumi bijuši Anetei Sietiņai. Parīzē gaidāms interesants vakars vieglatlētikā, pie komentētāju pults, kā allaž, būs Juris Valdovskis un Ieva Zunda.

programme.title: Tava darīšana
programme.desc: Izklaidējoši izglītojošs raidījums par uzņēmējdarbību, kas aicina iepazīt biznesa pasauli līksmā un atraktīvā veidā un iedvesmo nebaidīties apsvērt ideju par sava biznesa uzsākšanu. Uzņēmējas un televīzijas personības Martas Seleckas un biznesa stratēģa un uzņēmēja Jāņa Kļaviņa vadībā iepazīsti uzņēmējus, kas darbojas dažādās nozarēs visā Latvijā. Abi vadītāji, sarunājoties ar uzņēmējiem, mēģinās rast atbildes uz jautājumiem, kas parasti nomāc cilvēkus, kuri vēl tikai plāno uzsākt savu biznesu: "Cik svarīga ir ideja?", "Kur dabūt naudu?", "Vai es neizgāzīšos?" un citiem.

programme.title: Alana Tičmārša dārznieku klubiņš
programme.desc: Alans Tičmāršs atkal aicina mūs savā dārznieku klubiņā, piedāvājot vēl vairāk sezonālu padomu, ieteikumu un noderīgu atziņu. Kamila Baseta-Smita iepazīst reiz zudušu, bet tagad iespaidīgi atjaunotu dārzu Kornvolā, Klēra Lorija demonstrē savus iecienītākos telpaugu kopšanas rīkus, Henrijs Ags rāda, kā pašrocīgi izveidot dārza celiņu, bet ekodārzkopības entuziaste Popija Okoča aicina mūs savā Devonas dārzā uz ilgtspējīgas dārzkopības meistarklasi.

programme.title: Komisārs Reksis
programme.desc: Krimināllietu advokāts kopā ar sievu vakarā ir atbraukuši izbaudīt skaisto skatu uz Kolizeju, kad viņiem uzbrūk – vīrs saņem sitienu pa galvu un tiek ieslēgts mašīnas bagāžniekā, bet sieva saņem dūrienu sirdī ar tradicionālu Balkānu nazi un mirst. Nozieguma pēdas Davidi un Reksi aizved attālā pagātnē, kad Kosovā risinājās bruņots konflikts, kurā piedalījās arī itāļu kareivji.

programme.title: Aizraujošie vilcienu maršruti
programme.desc: Viesojoties Baijē, Maikls izzinās normaņu iebrukumu, kas uz visiem laikiem mainīja Lielbritānijas vēsturi. Vēsturiski nozīmīga bija arī Sabiedroto izcelšanās Normandijā Otrā pasaules kara laikā, un Anelā Maikls iepazīs šīs operācijas detaļas. Savukārt Aržantānā Maikls uzzinās ko vairāk par kādu karalisku zirgu šķirni, bet, tuvojoties Parīzei, ceļotājs nogaršos īstu ābolu brendiju, viesosies virvju rūpnīcā, kas pārveidota par muzeju, un izbaudīs mieru un skaistumu slavenā gleznotāja Kloda Monē dārzā Živernī.

programme.title: Policijas iecirknis
programme.desc: Melisa Korbeja no Neatkarīgo izmeklēšanu biroja izjautā Janiku, kurš apgalvo, ka iecirkņa komanda noklausījusies Nansijas sarunas. Komanda vienojas sadarboties ar Lorānu Vižē slepkavības lietā. Melisa izjautā Nansiju un pēcāk zvana Lorānam un aicina uz tikšanos.

programme.title: Vetārsts Jākobss
programme.desc: Švānicā, mazā ziemeļu ciemā pie Baltijas jūras, ierodas Hauke Jākobss, kurš tur grib atvērt veterināro klīniku. Tas visvairāk iepriecina agrākā veterinārārsta asistenti Jūli Kristianzeni, kura baidās palikt bez darba un dzīvesvietas. Arī vietējo policisti Lonu Fogtu ieinteresē jaunais ciema iedzīvotājs, kad viņa uzzina, ka Hauke agrāk strādājis Hamburgas policijā. Taču Hauke izvairās no uzmanības un nelabprāt runā par savu pagātni, dodot priekšroku izolētai dzīvei uz kutera kopā ar suni Holiju.

programme.title: Nelūgtie viesi
programme.desc: Oskars un Ričards uzzina par notikušo Leilas kāzās. Eva ierodas policijas iecirknī, lai atdotu disku, kuru atradusi pie Ralfa. Notiek Valtera Pētersona bēres. Kāds patiesībā bija mazpilsētā labi ieredzētais un mīlētais aktieris?

programme.title: Nelūgtie viesi
programme.desc: Rita pierunā Oskaru uzaicināt pusdienās priekšnieku Ričardu, tomēr tikšanās izvēršas ne tā, kā bija iecerēts. Atklājas vēl viens "skelets skapī" kādam no ballītes dalībniekiem. Ričardam un Oskaram beidzot izdodas notvert vienu no nelūgtajiem viesiem.

programme.title: Teātra garša
programme.desc: "Teātra garšā" satiekas divi aktieri no dažādiem teātriem, bet ar pārsteidzoši līdzīgu skatījumu uz dzīvi un skatuvi. Valmieras teātra aktrise Māra Mennika un Latvijas Nacionālā teātra aktieris Ainārs Ančevskis runā par teātra ikdienu, skatītājiem, kolēģiem un to īpašo sajūtu, kuras dēļ aktieri joprojām atgriežas uz skatuves. Sarunā atdzīvojas leģendas par teātra aizkulisēm, izbraukumu izrādēm, neaizmirstamiem kolēģiem un laiku, kad teātris bija vesela pasaule ar savām tradīcijām un nerakstītiem likumiem. Abi atzīst - teātra spēks slēpjas ne tikai izrādēs, bet arī cilvēkos, kopā būšanā un tajos retajos brīžos, kad starp skatuvi un skatītāju notiek īsta enerģijas apmaiņa Vai mūsdienu teātris ir mainījies? Kāpēc skatītājs joprojām ir vissvarīgākais izrādes dalībnieks? Un kas ir tā īstā teātra garša, kuru nevar aizstāt ne tehnoloģijas, ne modes tendences? Sirsnīga, asprātīga un nostalģijas pilna saruna par profesiju, kas reizēm nogurdina, reizēm izaicina, bet vienmēr ļauj satikt dzīvus cilvēkus un īstas emocijas.

programme.title: Dzimtas detektīvs
programme.desc: Latvijas Televīzijas (LTV) žurnālistes Ilzes Strengas un režisores Maijas Smildziņas veidots raidījums, kurā pētīs talantīgu un pazīstamu Latvijas ģimeņu vēsturi vairākās paaudzēs.

programme.title: Sajūti Latgali
programme.desc: "Sajūti Latgali" veidotāji piedāvā iespēju iepazīt Latgali tuvāk un sajust tās burvību. Ar stāstiem par uzņēmīgiem un interesantiem cilvēkiem tiks lauzti stereotipi par Latgali kā mazattīstītu reģionu. Raidījumos tiks stāstīts par latgaliešu valodu, Latgales vēstniecību "Gors", folkloras kopu "Svātra", jauniešu aktivitātēm Rēzeknes un Ciblas novados, kā arī Daugavpilī. Būs stāsti arī par katoļticību Latgalē, mazākumtautību integrāciju, mākslu, Latgales īpašajām tradīcijām, svētkiem, arheoloģiju Latgalē. Raidījumi "Sajūti LATGALI" stāstīs arī par lauksaimniecību un uzņēmīgiem cilvēkiem, kuri ikdienā attīsta Latgales reģionu.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation Special Report
programme.desc: With airplane travel becoming increasingly popular in a shrinking world and millions of passengers journeying this way every day, it is helpful to be aware of the potentail dangers involved. This show presents remarkable stories of some of the most catastrophic accidents in aviation history and investigates the causes of the accidents, what effect they had on the industry and the steps taken to ensure that they don't happen in the future. Each stand-alone episode features compelling re-enactments, expert analysis and interviews with those involved. The explanations for the accidents range from the explosive power of decompression to problems with autopilots and computerised control systems to air traffic control errors.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation Special Report
programme.desc: With airplane travel becoming increasingly popular in a shrinking world and millions of passengers journeying this way every day, it is helpful to be aware of the potentail dangers involved. This show presents remarkable stories of some of the most catastrophic accidents in aviation history and investigates the causes of the accidents, what effect they had on the industry and the steps taken to ensure that they don't happen in the future. Each stand-alone episode features compelling re-enactments, expert analysis and interviews with those involved. The explanations for the accidents range from the explosive power of decompression to problems with autopilots and computerised control systems to air traffic control errors.

programme.title: To Catch a Smuggler
programme.desc: Even during a pandemic, smuggling never stops. After adjusting tactics in the early days of the COVID crisis to meet the increasing flow of narcotics coming across our southern land borders, the Department of Homeland Security is now pivoting back to our nation's airports where international travel is starting to rev back up again. Whether narco-traffickers try to slip through an airport, seaport or land crossing, vigilant officers are on high-alert to stem the flow of illegal contraband. Using every tool available to them, DHS will stop at nothing to catch a smuggler.

programme.title: Border Protection Spain
programme.desc: A routine surveillance check of fishing boats has unpredicted consequences. A suspicious speedboat immediately raises a red flag at headquarters. An interception team is dispatched to investigate. In the Balearic Islands, Coastguard teams are confronted with an unexpected case of alleged domestic violence.

programme.title: Toronto Airport Uncovered
programme.desc: As thunder rumbles and rain pours, maintenance teams carry out urgent post winter repairs, but lightning forces them inside. A hardworking ground support engineer struggles to keep flights on time in the worsening rain. Repairs on a faulty 787 go to the wire. A ramp team has an hour to re-load an entire plane's cargo, and two dogs receive special treatment enroute to their loved ones.

programme.title: Toronto Airport Uncovered
programme.desc: Spring break brings a surge in passenger numbers and added pressures on airport staff and infrastructure: heavy bags rip a section of the baggage conveyor belt which needs fixing before the afternoon rush. A low-cost-holiday jet with millions of miles on the clock needs a new engine. Staff must race passengers from a delayed flight to their jet headed for the Caribbean, and an elite restaurant along with staff on the apron feel the heat as passenger numbers soar.

programme.title: Ice Road Rescue
programme.desc: When a salmon truck crashes into a ditch, it kicks off a night of havoc for Thord. While Thord and Bjoern attempt to rescue the truck and its load of valuable salmon, Thord must send rookie Domenic on a solo mission to control a chaotic situation, on a notorious accident black-spot. With Thords capacity pushed to the limit, he then dispatches Terje and Ørjan to rescue a bus thats crashed into a ditch. When Terje makes a critical mistake, it only makes matters worse.

programme.title: Ice Road Rescue
programme.desc: "Ice Road Rescue" portrays a group of heroic tow truck rescue workers. When winter hits Norway the transport roads turn into treacherous bobsleigh tracks. Every day the rescuers fight to keep this routes open by rescuing heavy trailers stuck in the mountain terrain. Winter storms, avalanches and lack of daylight through the winter season are just some of the challenges they have to face, working close to the polar circle. Extreme winter conditions that often make them risk their lives. "Ice Road Rescue" shows the ultimate man versus nature.

programme.title: Science of Stupid
programme.desc: Science of Stupid, series 8. Dallas Campbell hosts the show that combines serious science with some of the craziest, most spectacular user generated clips ever recorded. In each programme we show 40 to 50 clips of misadventure: ordinary folk making extraordinary mistakes and paying the price. We analyse the science behind the mishaps, with the help of bespoke animation and super slow-motion cinematography.

programme.title: Scrapyard Supercar
programme.desc: Petrolhead Shane Lynch is setting two teams of amateur mechanics a task of epic proportions; they have just four days to build monster machines that can out-perform a "top-trump" attribute of a supercar! Under the expert guidance of head-engineer Ralph Hosier, theyve got free reign in an automotive scrapyard to build their vehicles, before going head-to-head on the racetrack to see which performs best. Through the teams trials and tribulations, we will learn how supercars work, and learn just how hard it is to achieve perfection. From acceleration to braking, handling to grip, this is a true test of beauty vs beast. Scrapyard Supercar.

programme.title: Brain Games
programme.desc: Its a fact of life. From the minute were born, were all getting older. And while its long been believed that both your body and your brain deteriorate over time, recent studies show that may not always be the case. Some brain functions improve as we get older, while other dont fully develop until later in life! In this episode we explore your brain and how it doesnt always act its age. Through a series of games and experiments, you'll discover how your daily routines might be aging your brain . . . and how you can actually slow down the clock. And if you pay attention, youll discover the surprising answer about whether older brains or younger brains come out on top in this Brain Games "Battle of the Ages".

programme.title: Brain Games
programme.desc: What do you see when you look at the world? Does reality really exist the way you experience it? Your brain is constantly taking in different bits of information all at once to make meaningful patterns that eventually form a complete picture of the world around you. Whether it's light, shadow, distance, or sound, the way your brain perceives this information creates your unique perspective. But have you ever stopped to wonder if your brain is actually being fooled-or if your brain is fooling you? In this episode of Brain Games, you'll see how your brain gets tripped up by odd angles, how light and shadows play a crucial role in your perception of the world, how you can radically shift the way you see reality, and how your brain isn't always as honest with you as you think. Through a series of games and experiments, you'll discover why you shouldn't always believe what you see.

programme.title: Brain Games
programme.desc: This is a show about your brain and its imagination. We often associate imagination with creativity and the arts, but we don't always think about how important it is to our daily lives. If you play along you'll see how you can use your imagination to solve daily problems, you'll learn how to tap into the imaginative process, and that, with a little help, you can keep the good ideas flowing. Get ready to unleash your imagination…on Brain Games.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Every time a plane crashes, the world takes notice. And so do the experts whose job it is to figure out what happened. Air Crash Investigation uncovers the truth behind the most legendary aviation disasters, and every episode features eyewitness accounts, captivating reenactments, state-of-the-art CGI, and interviews with the investigators who ultimately determined what went wrong. This season on Air Crash Investigation: Conflicting stories emerge after a Swedish cargo plane spirals to the ground; an African airliner crashes in the wilderness and the cause proves too sinister to be believed; and, when a Pakistani passenger jet disappears on approach to Kathmandu, Nepalese investigators must determine how it ended up on a crash course with the Himalayas.

programme.title: Drain the Oceans
programme.desc: The Age of Dinosaurs - an ancient world of savage, lone T-rexes terrorizing dopey plant-eating diplodocus. So familiar… but so wrong. From the colours of their skin to the way they flock and herd, so much of what we think is true about dinosaurs is either out of date, guesswork, or all-out fantasy. Now a new generation of palaeontologists, armed with the latest tech, are challenging these popular caricatures to uncover the Real Jurassic Americas.

programme.title: Drain the Oceans
programme.desc: Archaeologists explore the coast of Oregon for the remains of a ship that sank over three hundred years ago. Native American oral histories tell of a shipwreck and its survivors. Porcelain and beeswax from the ship still wash up on shore. Archaeologists reconstruct their impression of the sunken wreck, using historical data and their own expertise, revealing how this giant ship carried hundreds of tons of cargo nearly halfway round the world.

programme.title: Gladiators: Warriors of the Ancient World
programme.desc: In the later Roman Empire it was gladiators and emperors alike frequently came from overseas. Emperor Septimius Severus was born in Africa and his wife in Syria, as was a gladiator named Flamma who was captured and sent to fight in Sicily. There, in the ludus, he fights alongside fellow gladiators such as Delicatus, forging bonds that define his career. His epitaph records 34 fights: 21 victories, 9 draws, and only 4 defeats. After his final bout, he dies at the age of 30. His gravestone exposes not only the brutal realities of gladiatorial life but also the comradeship and loyalty of the gladiators. Flamma's story embodies the grandeur, violence, and complexity of Rome's obsession with bloodsport.

programme.title: Gladiators: Warriors of the Ancient World
programme.desc: Emperor Commodus shocks Rome by casting aside tradition and becoming a gladiator. Over 14 days of extravagant games, he slays wild beasts, spars with helpless opponents, and indulges his fantasy of godhood - dressed as Hercules, demanding adoration. Behind the spectacle lies growing discontent: the Senate scorned, the treasury drained, and power abused, as he trains as a gladiator in his country estate. When Commodus plans to inaugurate the new year from the gladiators' barracks, his inner circle panics. Poisoned by his mistress Marcia and strangled by his trainer Narcissus, Commodus dies; a far cry from the hero he imagined. His death sparks civil war, ushering in the Severan dynasty. His legacy is condemned, and Commodus remains one of the most bizarre figures in Roman history, an emperor who tried to rule from the arena, not the throne.

programme.title: Destruction Decoded
programme.desc: This series will go back through the record to explore life-altering, earth-shattering, unforgettable events using a combination of carefully selected archive, cutting edge CGI and informative scripting in this popular science format. As well as exploring spectacular archive, illustrating the full toll these disasters can take, we'll dig into the science behind each event, shining a light on the most fascinating elements and giving an understanding on how and why these events occur.

programme.title: Megastructures
programme.desc: Exciting documentary series that shows viewers some extreme and extraordinary construction projects- the biggest, tallest, longest or deepest in the world, and the machines that are used to create such amazing structures. The series features interviews with designers and project managers, who present the problems of construction and the methodology or techniques used to overcome obstacles. Some ''megastructures'' included in the series are US Navy's aircraft carrier, the USS Ronald Reagan, highway with no speed limit built in Germany, undersea tunnel built between France and United Kingdom, world's longest suspension bridge in Japan, twin tower skyscraper in Kuala Lumpur, etc.

programme.title: Mega Marine Machines
programme.desc: A fire-scarred Great Lakes freighter completes its last journey to a family-run recycling yard on Lake Erie, where turning a dead ship into profit is anything but simple. At MRC's Port Colborne yard, the aging Cuyahoga must be stabilized, stripped and cut apart without contaminating the water or shoreline. Yard manager Jordan Elliott leads a crew working under constant pressure, where time is money and scrap prices can erase profits overnight. The operation hinges on high-risk moments: towing in a powerless ship, navigating brutal financial math, and executing the yard's signature move — using massive rubber airbags to haul the vessel out of the water. It's industrial recycling at full scale, offering a cleaner alternative to global shipbreaking while proving that modern methods can keep steel in circulation without poisoning the future.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation Special Report
programme.desc: With airplane travel becoming increasingly popular in a shrinking world and millions of passengers journeying this way every day, it is helpful to be aware of the potentail dangers involved. This show presents remarkable stories of some of the most catastrophic accidents in aviation history and investigates the causes of the accidents, what effect they had on the industry and the steps taken to ensure that they don't happen in the future. Each stand-alone episode features compelling re-enactments, expert analysis and interviews with those involved. The explanations for the accidents range from the explosive power of decompression to problems with autopilots and computerised control systems to air traffic control errors.

The explanations for the accidents range from the explosive power of decompression to problems with autopilots and computerised control systems to air traffic control errors.

programme.title: Gladiators: Warriors of the Ancient World
programme.desc: In 80 CE, Rome unveils the Colosseum with 100 days of games hosted by Emperor Titus. The spectacles include mock sea battles, gladiator combat, and savage beast hunts. At the centre of the blood-soaked spectacle is Carpophorus, an African beast hunter enslaved by the Romans. Trained in the art of killing wild animals, he becomes a star of the arena, famed for slaying lions, bears, rhinos, and more, drawing comparisons to Hercules. But while crowds cheer, Rome's games exact a toll. Ecosystems across the empire are ravaged; animals are hunted to extinction, and people are enslaved to supply the appetite for bloodsport. When Domitian succeeds Titus, the games grow even more extreme. Today, the Colosseum stands not just as a symbol of Roman might, but as a reminder of the violence, exploitation, and ecological devastation masked as spectacle.

programme.title: Gladiators: Warriors of the Ancient World
programme.desc: A Roman citizen Marcus Attilius chooses to become a gladiator to clear his debts. He wins fame and admiration, becoming a people's hero. His rise occurs as Pompeii's amphitheatre becomes a symbol of Roman dominance and spectacle. But less than two decades later, Vesuvius erupts, destroying the city. Marcus's fate remains a mystery, yet his story lives on through the legacy of Pompeii's games.

programme.title: Construction Fails
programme.desc: Florida experienced one of the deadliest structural failures in American history; India's dams are in distress after an avalanche of disasters; a partial collapse shuts down a Mallorca nightclub; and it's a race against time to save Italy's other leaning tower. We find out what happens when air gets into an airplane and how much huffing and puffing it actually takes to bring a brick house down.

programme.title: Construction Fails
programme.desc: When a faraway earthquake brings a Bangkok skyscraper crashing down, investigators wonder why it was the only one to fail. Was a deadly wind whipped up by the tallest tower in Yorkshire? The destruction of a Danish landmark highlights the risks of historic renovation, a Bronx building collapse shows that any renovation is risky if not done according to plan, and working with mobile cranes reveals a long history of contemporary errors.

programme.title: Disaster Autopsy
programme.desc: Disasters can strike anywhere, anytime. To find out why, expert analysis of the available evidence is used to recreate real world disasters in cutting edge 3D graphics. We can dissect them, peel back the layers, even freeze time to reveal a disaster's hidden and surprising causes – a paperwork error, a bad glue job, changing a restaurant opening hours. Whatever it is, Disaster Autopsy will uncover it.

programme.title: Mega Marine Machines
programme.desc: Across southern France, two radically different wind machines pursue the same modern obsession: more speed, more control and almost no margin for error. In Saint-Tropez, SailGP's F50 catamarans — often called Formula One on water — race inches apart on tight courses, where split-second decisions and flawless systems keep disaster at bay. In Leucate, the SP80 team takes a different path, training a kite-powered trimaran built for one purpose only: straight-line speed, with an audacious goal of 150 kilometers per hour. Though their designs diverge, both collide with the same invisible enemy — cavitation. The moment water vaporizes, lift collapses and control vanishes. As sailors, engineers and designers push beyond known limits, wind-driven sport becomes applied engineering, dragging marine technology into an uncertain and faster future.

programme.title: To Catch a Smuggler
programme.desc: Even during a pandemic, smuggling never stops. After adjusting tactics in the early days of the COVID crisis to meet the increasing flow of narcotics coming across our southern land borders, the Department of Homeland Security is now pivoting back to our nation's airports where international travel is starting to rev back up again. Whether narco-traffickers try to slip through an airport, seaport or land crossing, vigilant officers are on high-alert to stem the flow of illegal contraband. Using every tool available to them, DHS will stop at nothing to catch a smuggler.

programme.title: Border Protection Spain
programme.desc: A quiet day turns tense as drug traffickers lead the Coastguard's boats and helicopters on a high-speed chase as they try to reach Moroccan waters, where the Spanish teams have no jurisdiction. An illegal fishing boat has entered a protected nature reserve and must be stopped. And a distress call comes in for a dinghy drifting in dangerous waters with 14 people onboard.

programme.title: Toronto Airport Uncovered
programme.desc: At Toronto International Airport, multiple challenges push staff to their limits. An oversold flight needs passengers to surrender their seats, but will any volunteer? Cracked windows risk grounding a Dreamliner - they're still airworthy, but would anyone feel safe sitting beside them? And a rookie firefighter faces her biggest challenge, driving a state-of-the-art fire truck on a live airfield.

programme.title: Toronto Airport Uncovered
programme.desc: An Airside Electrical team investigates faulty airfield lights and finds that rodents, taking refuge from the brutal Canadian winter, have damaged the cabling. On the ramp, high winds make loading cargo difficult, and mean jets can't start their engines without help from one of the unsung heroes of the airport. And in security screening a scan reveals possible explosives in a passenger's baggage. Final

programme.title: Ice Road Rescue
programme.desc: In Hardanger, two smuglers have driven into a snowbank in the mountains, but it's hard for towing veteran Bjørn Lægreid to believe what's inside the vehicle. At the same time a Türkish driver is stuck in Odda for weeks on end, with summer tires and no driver's license. Tow truck boss Thord Paulsen tries to help with new tires, but there's problems with the payment. In Finnsnes, Northern Norway, Frank Sebulonsen and his apprentice go out to rescue a truck blocking the road, but as he pulls the wires around a tree, they put their lives at risk as things don't go as planned.

programme.title: Ice Road Rescue
programme.desc: After a period of warm temperatures and few rescues, tow truck boss Thord heaves a sigh of relief when it starts snowing. In the snowstorm, a 20-ton transporter slides off the road, and a car falls into a deep ditch. Thord decides to rescue them both. He needs all the work he can get to keep his business going. On Bjorn's territory, a foreign driver is stuck on a mountain pass. He has failed to put tyre chains on, which makes Bjorn grumpy.

programme.title: Science of Stupid
programme.desc: Science of Stupid, series 8. Dallas Campbell hosts the show that combines serious science with some of the craziest, most spectacular user generated clips ever recorded. In each programme we show 40 to 50 clips of misadventure: ordinary folk making extraordinary mistakes and paying the price. We analyse the science behind the mishaps, with the help of bespoke animation and super slow-motion cinematography.

programme.title: Scrapyard Supercar
programme.desc: Petrolhead Shane Lynch is setting two teams of amateur mechanics a task of epic proportions; they have just four days to build monster machines that can out-perform a "top-trump" attribute of a supercar! Under the expert guidance of head-engineer Ralph Hosier, theyve got free reign in an automotive scrapyard to build their vehicles, before going head-to-head on the racetrack to see which performs best. Through the teams trials and tribulations, we will learn how supercars work, and learn just how hard it is to achieve perfection. From acceleration to braking, handling to grip, this is a true test of beauty vs beast. Scrapyard Supercar.

programme.title: Brain Games
programme.desc: This is a show about your brain and trust. Does it sometimes seem like you have to be on your guard all the time against untrustworthy advertisers, politicians, and other people? So how do you maintain a level of trust in an untrustworthy world - and what is trust anyway? Through a series of fun and interactive games, you'll learn to trust others a little more and your own brain a little less! Prepare to put your trust in Brain Games.

programme.title: Brain Games
programme.desc: National Geographic Channel's Emmy-nominated series Brain Games returns this summer with 10 new mind-blowing episodes! Host Jason Silva gets inside your head and shows you what's really going on in there with an intricate series of interactive experiments designed to mess with your mind and reveal the inner-workings of your brain. Hailed by critics as "tremendous fun" that "makes science entertaining," Brain Games turns your mind's eye inwards for a fascinating journey into the three and a half pounds of tissue that makes you... you.

programme.title: Brain Games
programme.desc: Whether its remembering where you parked the car, or just finding the light switch in the morning, navigating your busy world can be tough. Luckily your brain has a built-in navigation system to help make sense of your surroundings. In fact, recent discoveries prove that the brain uses place cells and direction cells to help get us to where were going. In this episode we explore spatial awareness. Its how your brain tells you where you are. Through a series of games and experiments well test the boundaries of your brains hardwired sense of direction, and prove how you arent always aware of your surroundings or even your body. Plus youll learn a surprising technique to enhance your spatial memory.

programme.title: Seconds from Disaster
programme.desc: Waco, Texas. On February 28th 1993 the Bureau of Alcohol Tobacco and Firearms raid a compound belonging to a religious cult called the Branch Davidians. They attempt to arrest cult leader David Koresh for alleged firearms offences. A gunfight breaks out that leaves six Branch Davidians and four ATF agents dead. The FBI arrives to take control but the situation escalates into one of the Americas longest sieges. After a fifty-one day stand off the FBI launches a dawn assault. Using military tanks they inject tear gas through the walls and windows in an attempt to force the Branch Davidians out. Besieged cult members refuse to surrender and a disastrous fire engulfs their compound in less than twenty minutes. Nearly 80 people including twenty-eight children were killed during the fire. [add] Seconds from Disaster counts down to the moment fire breaks out and investigates whether the Branch Davidians were led to their deaths by charismatic cult leader David Koresh or killed by murderous Federal agents.

programme.title: Seconds from Disaster
programme.desc: In March 2011, as Japan reels from the most powerful earthquake in its history, a 14 metre-high tsunami surges over the Fukushima Dai-ichi nuclear power plant, knocking out its power supply and essential cooling systems. With the plant blacked out, engineers face nuclear meltdown. The reactors begin to overheat leading to two huge explosions that tear the plant apart and dispersing radiation. As Japan faces the worst nuclear emergency since Chernobyl, an international nuclear expert will investigate exactly what happed at Fukushima and see what, if anything, could have been done to prevent it.

programme.title: Ancient Structures: Secrets Revealed
programme.desc: Throughout history, the colossal monuments of our ancestors have embodied their determination to leave a lasting mark on the world. The Colosseum — a spectacular feat of engineering and design that once hosted violent spectacles for thousands — holds the secrets of Roman ingenuity. The serpentine expanse of the Great Wall of China, winding over 21,000 kilometers, conceals clues of its construction and surprising ingredients that not only fortify its strength but also reflect the resourcefulness of the builders charged with protecting an empire. Malbork Castle, the largest brick fortress in the world, showcases the military prowess of the Teutonic Knights. Its strategic design and defensive features hold untold stories of battles fought and won.

programme.title: Ancient Structures: Secrets Revealed
programme.desc: Humanity's relentless drive to innovate has left an indelible mark on our planet's most volatile landscapes. Atop the sheer volcanic plug known as Sigiriya, a Sri Lankan king builds an impregnable fortress, complete with innovative hydraulics and stunning frescoes. On Easter Island, the resilient Rapa Nui people carve and transport colossal moai statues, their cultural practices enduring beyond European contact. And in India, the Kailasa Temple in the Ellora Caves stands as an architectural marvel. Inspired by the legend of a queen's vow, the miraculous structure is carved top-down from solid basaltic rock.

programme.title: Airport Security: To Catch a Smuggler Latin America Compilation
programme.desc: Parents with kids are arrested for drug-trafficking. From Airport Security Colombia and Peru, cocaine busts that include families. A mother with kids going to Barcelona carries cocaine in food packages. A man with kids at home confesses. A mother leaving the country with kids uses fake documents. A woman with her infant son enters the country with help from officials. A couple are not what they seem. The woman did it to help her daughter.

programme.title: Airport Security: To Catch a Smuggler Latin America Compilation
programme.desc: Carriers are often defiant towards officials, but crumble in the end. Cases of protest and denial from Airport Security Colombia and Peru. Sisters deny ingesting drugs but break down when one reveals she is pregnant. A drunk man denies the checked bag is his but is arrested and confesses. A young woman claims she is innocent but may have a mental illness. A young man with liquid cocaine in beer lies at first, but then breaks down.

programme.title: Amsterdam Central 24/7
programme.desc: The Christmas holidays begin under extreme conditions as the heaviest snowstorm in 5 years slams into the region, bringing transport to a near standstill. At Central Station, the Christmas spirit descends as thousands of additional holiday passengers are expected despite the weather, turning an already busy period into a logistical battle. Inside the control room, Code Orange is declared as delays cascade across the network. A stalled train compounds the disruption, while platforms grow crowded. Assistant station manager Michel coordinates Christmas decorations while Ticket & Service staff Alexandra and Gusta help create a festive atmosphere. Meanwhile, Safety & Service officers Menno and Baran respond to one incident after another. With snow piling up and pressure mounting, everybody must work together to prevent total gridlock.

programme.title: Ancient Structures: Secrets Revealed
programme.desc: The Inca fortress of Sacsayhuamán stands high above Cusco as a colossal mystery of construction. Its gargantuan stones, so precisely fitted, seem to defy rational explanation and have given rise to tales of demonic assistance. Deep in Rajasthan, India, the Chand Baori stepwell plunges 13 stories into the earth, its 3,500 perfectly arranged steps forming a hypnotic geometry so meticulous that locals whisper of unholy pacts. And in the heart of Paris, the Notre-Dame Cathedral soars skyward, its Gothic spires and intricate ironwork pushed medieval engineering to such extremes that stories circulated of dark bargains. Did the creators of these structures truly strike a "deal with the devil," or do these wonders simply reflect the often-misunderstood genius of our ancestors?

programme.title: Ancient Structures: Secrets Revealed
programme.desc: Commissioned by Emperor Shah Jahan as a mausoleum for his beloved wife, the Taj Mahal stands as a crown jewel of Mughal architecture and an embodiment of eternal devotion. Beneath Germany's 11th century Speyer Cathedral, Salian emperors built a cavernous crypt, revealing astounding visions of the afterlife and their desire to secure a place in eternity. Carved high into the cliffs of Turkey, the intricate Lycian tombs offer a window into a mysterious ancient civilization's vibrant beliefs about the afterlife. Each monumental structure holds valuable clues to unravel the mysteries of how ancient ancestors approached the inevitability of death. More than mere burial sites, they reveal complex philosophies about life and what lies beyond.

programme.title: Airport Security: Peru
programme.desc: Security teams at Lima, Peru's airport work 24-7 to stop illegal activity. The biggest threat: cocaine smuggling. Handmade mats include additional handiwork: 100's of bags of cocaine. A student on vacation is carrying more than keepsakes: a hidden compartment hides cocaine. A Latvian carrier wants to cooperate. Cocaine hidden inside a wooden sculpture of Jesus Christ. Police listen in as a carrier takes a call from his contact.

programme.title: Airport Security: Peru
programme.desc: Security teams at Lima, Peru's airport work 24-7 to stop illegal activity. The biggest threat: cocaine smuggling. Two Ukrainian passengers are caught with cocaine. And one may have tricked the other. Police will need a translator to sort it out. A couple celebrating their anniversary may be taking home more than just memories. Customs find more than 130,000 euros hidden in the carry-on of an arriving passenger and move in to investigate.

programme.title: Airport Security: Peru
programme.desc: Security teams at Lima, Peru's airport work 24-7 to stop illegal activity. The biggest threat: cocaine smuggling. A couple is caught carrying cocaine in bottled beverages. And the girlfriend may have been in the dark about the entire scheme. Cocaine is uncovered, disguised as packaged food. And this may not be the carrier's first job. Police discover cocaine sewn into panels of an insulated jacket and that could be just the beginning.

programme.title: Airport Security: Peru
programme.desc: Security teams at Lima, Peru's airport work 24-7 to stop illegal activity. The biggest threat: cocaine smuggling. X-Ray scans show unusual shapes in a woman's platform shoes - and something shocking inside her body. A suspect says he has information to take down drug trafficking organizations. A suspect on a stopover may be carrying cocaine hidden in drink bottles. Energy pills destined for England may contain something else: high purity cocaine.

programme.title: Airport Security: Colombia
programme.desc: Antinarcotics police officers at El Dorado International Airport, in Bogota, Colombia, fight the most daring and unexpected attempts to smuggle drugs out of the country. Behind the apparent innocence of a young woman traveling with her stepmother, the officers stop one of the biggest drug smuggling attempts in years. Later, they won't believe their eyes when the X-ray machine reveals that a young man is wearing a cocaine-filled adult diaper. Immigration officers must contend with an out of control Cuban passenger to whom they are forced to deport. Later, tragedy unfolds when they must prevent a mother from traveling with her young daughter to Europe. A thrifty passenger manages to pass through all airport security check-points with two kilograms of cocaine hidden in his carry-on bag, but he will be cornered as the officers' well-trained sense of smell will trigger and make him a suspect. A passenger on her way to the Dominican Republic denies being the owner of a bag as it's about to be searched. The inspection will reveal something unexpected.

programme.title: Amsterdam Central 24/7
programme.desc: The Christmas holidays begin under extreme conditions as the heaviest snowstorm in 5 years slams into the region, bringing transport to a near standstill. At Central Station, the Christmas spirit descends as thousands of additional holiday passengers are expected despite the weather, turning an already busy period into a logistical battle. Inside the control room, Code Orange is declared as delays cascade across the network. A stalled train compounds the disruption, while platforms grow crowded. Assistant station manager Michel coordinates Christmas decorations while Ticket & Service staff Alexandra and Gusta help create a festive atmosphere. Meanwhile, Safety & Service officers Menno and Baran respond to one incident after another. With snow piling up and pressure mounting, everybody must work together to prevent total gridlock.

programme.title: Ancient Structures: Secrets Revealed
programme.desc: The Inca fortress of Sacsayhuamán stands high above Cusco as a colossal mystery of construction. Its gargantuan stones, so precisely fitted, seem to defy rational explanation and have given rise to tales of demonic assistance. Deep in Rajasthan, India, the Chand Baori stepwell plunges 13 stories into the earth, its 3,500 perfectly arranged steps forming a hypnotic geometry so meticulous that locals whisper of unholy pacts. And in the heart of Paris, the Notre-Dame Cathedral soars skyward, its Gothic spires and intricate ironwork pushed medieval engineering to such extremes that stories circulated of dark bargains. Did the creators of these structures truly strike a "deal with the devil," or do these wonders simply reflect the often-misunderstood genius of our ancestors?

programme.title: Ancient Structures: Secrets Revealed
programme.desc: Commissioned by Emperor Shah Jahan as a mausoleum for his beloved wife, the Taj Mahal stands as a crown jewel of Mughal architecture and an embodiment of eternal devotion. Beneath Germany's 11th century Speyer Cathedral, Salian emperors built a cavernous crypt, revealing astounding visions of the afterlife and their desire to secure a place in eternity. Carved high into the cliffs of Turkey, the intricate Lycian tombs offer a window into a mysterious ancient civilization's vibrant beliefs about the afterlife. Each monumental structure holds valuable clues to unravel the mysteries of how ancient ancestors approached the inevitability of death. More than mere burial sites, they reveal complex philosophies about life and what lies beyond.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation Special Report
programme.desc: With airplane travel becoming increasingly popular in a shrinking world and millions of passengers journeying this way every day, it is helpful to be aware of the potentail dangers involved. This show presents remarkable stories of some of the most catastrophic accidents in aviation history and investigates the causes of the accidents, what effect they had on the industry and the steps taken to ensure that they don't happen in the future. Each stand-alone episode features compelling re-enactments, expert analysis and interviews with those involved. The explanations for the accidents range from the explosive power of decompression to problems with autopilots and computerised control systems to air traffic control errors.

programme.title: To Catch a Smuggler
programme.desc: Even during a pandemic, smuggling never stops. After adjusting tactics in the early days of the COVID crisis to meet the increasing flow of narcotics coming across our southern land borders, the Department of Homeland Security is now pivoting back to our nation's airports where international travel is starting to rev back up again. Whether narco-traffickers try to slip through an airport, seaport or land crossing, vigilant officers are on high-alert to stem the flow of illegal contraband. Using every tool available to them, DHS will stop at nothing to catch a smuggler.

programme.title: Border Protection Spain
programme.desc: During the night, a call from a distressed mother alerts the Coastguard to a potential suicide attempt in a treacherous area. Aided by helicopters, a team intercepts drug traffickers carrying over 3 tons of hashish. Fishermen using illegal devices try to fish in protected waters and a German sailboat raises suspicion.

programme.title: Inside Airport: Lost & Found
programme.desc: Travelers are reunited with lost treasures, including an expensive pair of vintage Air Jordans, sweaty boxing gear, and a beloved stuffed animal. In Tampa, the K9 unit is called in to ensure an abandoned bag does not contain explosives, and in Norfolk, the airport's auction of lost items, including a van converted into a mobile barber shop, raises nearly $55,000.

programme.title: Inside Airport: Lost & Found
programme.desc: A lone diamond from grandma's ring is lost at Pittsburgh's airport by a young bride. Lost-and-found workers at Tampa International desperately try to find the owner of a fanny pack as it contains much-needed medication and $3,000 in cash. Travelers to a comic convention in Salt Lake City leave behind peculiar objects, including unique fan art acquired at the site.

programme.title: Ice Road Rescue
programme.desc: "Ice Road Rescue" portrays a group of heroic tow truck rescue workers. When winter hits Norway the transport roads turn into treacherous bobsleigh tracks. Every day the rescuers fight to keep this routes open by rescuing heavy trailers stuck in the mountain terrain. Winter storms, avalanches and lack of daylight through the winter season are just some of the challenges they have to face, working close to the polar circle. Extreme winter conditions that often make them risk their lives. "Ice Road Rescue" shows the ultimate man versus nature.

programme.title: Austria's Wild Heritage - One Country Six National Parks
programme.desc: The second part focuses on the challenges of the future: How do the national parks deal with invasive species from outside and what success stories can be reported? For instance, in the Hohe Tauern National Park the previously extinct ibexes and bearded vultures have been reintroduced. In the Gesäuse National Park Avalanches created one of the most species-rich habitats, which rare butterflies like the Red Apollo colonize.

programme.title: Sharks Up Close with Bertie Gregory
programme.desc: Bertie heads to South Africa for his most dangerous mission yet. The wild waters here are a hotspot for one of the ocean's most famous and fearsome predators: the great white shark. Bertie will attempt to film them hunting seals underwater without the use of a protective cage. It's highly risky, but filming without the cage is the very best way to see them behaving naturally.

programme.title: Austria's Wild Heritage - One Country Six National Parks
programme.desc: The first part explains the beginnings of the national parks in Austria, which were characterized by the visions of a few pioneers and the civil disobedience of many. One remembers the occupation of a floodplain in the conflict over the construction of a power station or protests against building a cannon firing range. But of course, this production also knows how to inspire with fascinating nature stories and animal shots.

programme.title: Savage Kingdom
programme.desc: The sparse African Savannah can be a fearsome place for both herds of powerful prey and the lurking predators who hunt them down. In this captivating documentary series from National Geographic, the relationship between predator and prey is closely examined, exploring the fight for survival for both sets of animals. These herds are full of powerful or agile animals, making the job of a predator to feed itself and its family a troublesome task. But the African predators are ruthless and proficient hunters, and if a herd is infiltrated, or a straggling member is targeted, they will struggle to evade these savage carnivores.

Following a young cheetah mother over 18-months as she teaches her three cubs the secrets of the hunt.

programme.title: Return of the Predators
programme.desc: After 30 years of war and destruction, Gorongosa National Park in Mozambique has undergone a remarkable restoration. Herbivores once again bound across the plains, but hunters have been slower to return, leaving the park out of balance...until now!

programme.title: The Way Of the Cheetah
programme.desc: Cheetah are the most fragile cats physically and now there are under 7,000 left in the world. Our story tells of Immani, a sleek female with 4 cubs as they navigate the plains of the Mara ecosystem - and living here is also a coalition of 5 males; to save her cubs, Immani must avoid them. A film by Dereck and Beverly Joubert who have made dozens of big cat films, but never one on cheetahs.

programme.title: Cat Wars: Lion vs Cheetah
programme.desc: Caught on tape in Africa's wild Serengeti is a stunning act of violence between two top predators. Three cheetahs are brutally attacked by two male lions - the first time an attack like this has ever been filmed. Now, filmmaker Leo Kuenkel, who witnessed the attack, is trying to make sense of it. Was this a once-in-a-lifetime "perfect storm" event? Or do these iconic African cats have a deep-set, sinister reason to fight to the death?

programme.title: Cheetahs Up Close with Bertie Gregory
programme.desc: Bertie arrives in the Serengeti as the spectacular wildebeest migration kicks off. He's here to film the fastest land animal on Earth: the cheetah. He gets close to a mother caring for her tiny cubs and a young group of males executing phenomenal hunts as a team, and learns about the unexpected challenges the species face.

programme.title: Serengeti Speed Queen
programme.desc: Nzuri is the Speed Queen of the Serengeti - but being fast isn't enough. She's constantly bullied by hyenas on the grassland and hunted by lions in the marsh. When two of her cubs are killed, the family is exiled to the transition forest. There, she learns to adapt her hunting methods and adds strategy to speed in order to outwit her enemies and steer her remaining cubs successfully to adulthood.

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol
programme.desc: With more than 19,000 patients, Dr. Pol has seen it all. Specializing in large farm animals, this senior is anything but retiring as he takes an old-school, non-nonsense approach to veterinary medicine. Unflappable and unstoppable, this doc routinely puts in 14-hour days and is a legend in his community. This new series travels with him across rural Michigan to care for every family pet and head of livestock in need of his expertise and kindness.

programme.desc: North America doesn't get much colder, nor any darker than Alaska in winter. It's not a place you mess with, unless you've got a wild side. As winter breaks, carnivores emerge on Alaska's wide-open spaces, leaving prey animals no place to hide. Wolves chase caribou with ferocious intensity, brown bears battle for rights to a buffet and wolverines make short work of prey 100 times their size. Alaska's deadliest thrive in one of America's last wild frontiers.

programme.title: Alaska's Deadliest: Predator Prowl
programme.desc: The biggest state in the union is also home to some of the deadliest predators. Alaska is one of the few remaining true wildernesses left on the planet. With its harsh environment, extreme cold and constant winter darkness it is not a place for the fainthearted. As springtime buds and the sun raises its head above the horizon, the state's predatory carnivores emerge on to the vast landscapes to hunt for food, with wolves, brown bears and wolverines dispatching prey with ease. In the waters along the coastline, giant orcas and salmon sharks track and kill their quarry while tiny terrors hide in the channels and make good use of their venomous attacks.

programme.title: Australia's Land of the Ancients
programme.desc: Australias Land of the Ancients explores the unique and ancient landscape of northeastern Australia, the most biodiverse region on the continent. From Crocodiles lying in wait for fish and hunting feral pigs to caring marsupial mothers of the far north, the film highlights some of the incredible species as they struggle to survive in their harsh environment amid a changing landscape.

programme.title: Kingdom of the Blue Whale
programme.desc: Supported by the National Geographic Society, the world's eminent blue whale scientists embark on a revolutionary mission: they'll find, identify and tag California blue whales, use the DNA samples to confirm the sex of individual whales - then rejoin the massive creatures' stunning migration when they collect at a chimera known as the Costa Rica Dome. These experts have observed, firsthand, courtship behavior among the whales at the moving mass of krill and currents 500 miles off the coast of Costa Rica. Now they hope to find - and record - the Holy Grail of blue whale science … the breeding and calving grounds of the biggest mammals in the sea.

programme.title: Extraordinary Australia
programme.desc: From lush ancient rainforests to wet grassland and dry eucalyptus forest, Australias diverse habitats are home to an array of weird and wonderful creatures found nowhere else on the planet. programme.title: Kingdom of the Polar Bears
programme.desc: As the Arctic changes faster than ever, a team of polar bear guides prepares for an epic journey; a first-ever attempt to follow the bears on the sea ice of Hudson Bay. In this high-stakes high-reward venture, they will document the secret world of bears, a mysterious and disappearing realm that is the bears key to survival. Life on the ice is a critical time for these bears. It also remains undocumented, deemed too dangerous for humans to follow, hinted at only through aerial reconnaissance and satellite collar research. The team, armed with traditional ecological knowledge and the latest 4K camera technology, will witness never- before-seen seal hunting strategies and document rapid adaptations to climate change, including whale predation and open-water hunting.

Only if he can prove his worth will the jaguar be able to claim his throne in one of the last truly wild paradises on the planet.

programme.title: Killer Snakes
programme.desc: Packed with a potent neurotoxic venom, one family of snakes kill more people than any other on earth. These are the elapids - a family that includes the the black mamba, the king cobra, the inland taipan, and the krait. Their venom is one of the most toxic substances on earth; but in a strange twist of fate, it can also save lives. Scientists around the world race to uncover the secrets of these killer snakes - without getting bitten in the process.

programme.title: Australia's Land of the Ancients
programme.desc: Australias Land of the Ancients explores the unique and ancient landscape of northeastern Australia, the most biodiverse region on the continent. From Crocodiles lying in wait for fish and hunting feral pigs to caring marsupial mothers of the far north, the film highlights some of the incredible species as they struggle to survive in their harsh environment amid a changing landscape.

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol
programme.desc: With more than 19,000 patients, Dr. Pol has seen it all. Specializing in large farm animals, this senior is anything but retiring as he takes an old-school, non-nonsense approach to veterinary medicine. Unflappable and unstoppable, this doc routinely puts in 14-hour days and is a legend in his community. This new series travels with him across rural Michigan to care for every family pet and head of livestock in need of his expertise and kindness.

programme.title: Extraordinary Australia
programme.desc: From lush ancient rainforests to wet grassland and dry eucalyptus forest, Australias diverse habitats are home to an array of weird and wonderful creatures found nowhere else on the planet. From the bizarre anatomy of the platypus to the savage screams of Tasmanian devils, the creatures of Australia rely on extraordinary adaptations to survive in continents vast and diverse habitats.

programme.title: Kingdom of the Blue Whale
programme.desc: Supported by the National Geographic Society, the world's eminent blue whale scientists embark on a revolutionary mission: they'll find, identify and tag California blue whales, use the DNA samples to confirm the sex of individual whales - then rejoin the massive creatures' stunning migration when they collect at a chimera known as the Costa Rica Dome. These experts have observed, firsthand, courtship behavior among the whales at the moving mass of krill and currents 500 miles off the coast of Costa Rica. Now they hope to find - and record - the Holy Grail of blue whale science … the breeding and calving grounds of the biggest mammals in the sea.

programme.title: Kingdom of the Polar Bears
programme.desc: As the Arctic changes faster than ever, a team of polar bear guides prepares for an epic journey; a first-ever attempt to follow the bears on the sea ice of Hudson Bay. In this high-stakes high-reward venture, they will document the secret world of bears, a mysterious and disappearing realm that is the bears key to survival. Life on the ice is a critical time for these bears. It also remains undocumented, deemed too dangerous for humans to follow, hinted at only through aerial reconnaissance and satellite collar research. The team, armed with traditional ecological knowledge and the latest 4K camera technology, will witness never- before-seen seal hunting strategies and document rapid adaptations to climate change, including whale predation and open-water hunting.

programme.title: Rabla komanda

programme.title: Rabla komanda
programme.desc: Kad Ātrmeistars nozog Rabla komandas autobusu, ķepaiņiem tas jāatgūst, lai paspētu uz Sjerras Spīdošās koncertu. Celtnieklīcī ir lieliska diena pludmalei! Rabla komandai jābūvē glābēju tornis, lai pludmalē būtu aboslūti droši.

programme.title: Ķepu patruļa
programme.desc: "Ķepu patruļa" ir seriāls pirmsskolas vecuma bērniem, kura galvenie varoņi ir seši varonīgi kucēni Čeiss, Māršals, Rokijs, Zuma, Rabls un Skaja, kuru saimnieks ir tehnoloģijas pārzinošais 10 gadus vecais zēns Raiders. Viņiem ir unikālas problēmu risināšanas spējas, stilīgi braucamrīki un daudz kucēniem raksturīga mīļa humora. "Kepu patruļa" dodas bīstamās glābšanas misijās, lai Piedzīvojumu līča iedzīvotāji būtu drošībā. Māršals – suns ugunsdzējs, Čeiss – suns policists, Skaja, kura lido savā helikopterā, un citi – katram kucēnam ir sava īpaša personība un spējas, atspoguļojot kopīga darba un pilsoniskās atbildības nozīmību. Viņiem visiem uz muguras ir īpašas mugursomas, lai viņi būtu spējīgi paveikt visu, sākot no kaķēnu glābšanas līdz vilciena apturēšanai, neļaujot tam nokrist no klints. Lai cik liels būtu piedzīvojums, "Ķepu patruļai" vienmēr atliek laiks spēlēm, jautrībai un tam, lai Raiders pakasa aiz auss. Interesants "Ķepu patruļas" fakts – Raders izglāba visus kucēnus un iemācīja tiem viņu spējas.

programme.title: Bleizs un automonstri
programme.desc: Bleizs un automonstri ir interaktīvs seriāls datorgrafikā par Bleizu, lieliskāko automonstru pasaulē, tā vadītāju astoņgadīgu zēnu vārdā Eidžejs un viņu piedzīvojumiem Asupilī. Asupilī nav lielākas zvaigznes par Bleizu. Viņš ir čempions sacīkšu trasē un varonis ārpus tās. Kad vien ir kāda ķibele, visi vēršas pie viņa, jo zina, ka Bleizs spēj to, ko nespēj citas mašīnas. Viņš ir ātrākais automonstrs pilsētā - viņam piemīt bliezienātrums! Liekot lietā savas zināšanas, Bleizs spēj tikt galā ar jebkādu izaicinājumu. Ja situācija kļūst sarežģīta, viņš spēj iztēloties sevi par jebkuru mašīnu, pārvērsties par to un pavisam viegli atrisināt ikvienu problēmu.

programme.title: Dora
programme.desc: Jauni piedzīvojumi ar DORU! Pievienojies drošajai pasaules pētītājai Dorai un viņas labākajam draugam Zābaciņam viņu kopīgajos ceļojumos pa maģisko lietusmežu, kurā var notikt - un notiek - brīnumu lietas. Let's go!

programme.title: Bena un Hollijas mazā karaļvalsts
programme.desc: Mazā karaļvalsts varbūt nav varen milzīga, taču tā ir ļoti maģiska. Un, kā katrā kārtīgā karaļvalstī pieklājas, tai ir savs karalis un karaliene, kas dzīvo pilī kopā ar trim meitām: astoņgadīgo Holiju un mazajām dvīnēm Deiziju un Popiju. Savukārt elfi mīt Lielajā elfu kokā, kur it viss ir vienuviet: skola, bibliotēka, daudzdzīvokļu nams un pat rotaļlietu un burvju nūjiņu fabrika. Šis koks ir mājvieta arī elfiņam Benam, pasaku princeses Holijas neparastajam draugam. Abi kopā viņi nemitīgi iekuļas jautros piedzīvojumos, mācoties kopīgi sadarboties, dalīties un risināt sarežģītas situācijas.

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!
programme.desc: Kamēr ģimene veido keramikas izstrādājumus, Barbabravo un Barbagudrais mēģina uzstādīt pasaules rekordu ar siera suflē. Barbapapas nolemj doties uz parku. Kamēr brālis un māsa spēlējas, Barbaliba mēģina visu kontrolēt.

programme.title: Krokodila kungs

programme.title: Bleizs un automonstri
programme.desc: Bleizs un automonstri ir interaktīvs seriāls datorgrafikā par Bleizu, lieliskāko automonstru pasaulē, tā vadītāju astoņgadīgu zēnu vārdā Eidžejs un viņu piedzīvojumiem Asupilī. Asupilī nav lielākas zvaigznes par Bleizu. Viņš ir čempions sacīkšu trasē un varonis ārpus tās. Kad vien ir kāda ķibele, visi vēršas pie viņa, jo zina, ka Bleizs spēj to, ko nespēj citas mašīnas. Viņš ir ātrākais automonstrs pilsētā - viņam piemīt bliezienātrums! Liekot lietā savas zināšanas, Bleizs spēj tikt galā ar jebkādu izaicinājumu. Ja situācija kļūst sarežģīta, viņš spēj iztēloties sevi par jebkuru mašīnu, pārvērsties par to un pavisam viegli atrisināt ikvienu problēmu.

programme.title: Rabla komanda
programme.desc: Mēre Greitveja un Dakija Dū kungs vēlas nodemonstrēt savas izpletņlēkšanas prasmes. Taču, kad patraucē vējš, suņi palīdz viņiem lēkt ar izpletni uz zemes! Kad Vīleram un cūkai Trifelei nesanāk slidot, komanda rod risinājumu uz riteņiem!

programme.title: Rabla komanda
programme.desc: Gatavojoties Banānu dienai, Gabrielam un Sjerrai Spīdošajai vajag būvnieku palīdzību, tāpēc Rabla komanda ķeras pie darba.

programme.title: Ķepu patruļa
programme.desc: "Ķepu patruļa" ir seriāls pirmsskolas vecuma bērniem, kura galvenie varoņi ir seši varonīgi kucēni Čeiss, Māršals, Rokijs, Zuma, Rabls un Skaja, kuru saimnieks ir tehnoloģijas pārzinošais 10 gadus vecais zēns Raiders. Viņiem ir unikālas problēmu risināšanas spējas, stilīgi braucamrīki un daudz kucēniem raksturīga mīļa humora. "Kepu patruļa" dodas bīstamās glābšanas misijās, lai Piedzīvojumu līča iedzīvotāji būtu drošībā. Māršals – suns ugunsdzējs, Čeiss – suns policists, Skaja, kura lido savā helikopterā, un citi – katram kucēnam ir sava īpaša personība un spējas, atspoguļojot kopīga darba un pilsoniskās atbildības nozīmību. Viņiem visiem uz muguras ir īpašas mugursomas, lai viņi būtu spējīgi paveikt visu, sākot no kaķēnu glābšanas līdz vilciena apturēšanai, neļaujot tam nokrist no klints. Lai cik liels būtu piedzīvojums, "Ķepu patruļai" vienmēr atliek laiks spēlēm, jautrībai un tam, lai Raiders pakasa aiz auss. Interesants "Ķepu patruļas" fakts – Raders izglāba visus kucēnus un iemācīja tiem viņu spējas.

programme.title: Tims Rekss kosmosā
programme.desc: Tims un Kaja meklē pludmalē apraktos niekus. Tims atbrīvojas no vecajām lietām, bet drīz saprot, ka ne visam vieta miskastē. Tims, Tija un Tomijs cenšas pārliecināt mammu un tēti par labu mīlulim.

programme.title: Ķepaiņu lietas
programme.desc: Antropomorfisku dzīvnieku pasaulē Sems Snovs un Kita Keisija ir elitāri KLEID (Slepenā dzīvnieku detektīvu ekspertu līga) aģenti, kas apceļo pasauli un risina noslēpumus, liekot lietā problēmu risināšanas un dzīvnieku faktu pārzināšanas prasmes.

programme.title: Briežu komanda
programme.desc: Mūsu varoņi ir atpakaļ, un šoreiz Briežu komanda pametīs šīs pasaules robežas! Gatavojies varonīgai planētas glābšanai ar dažādiem uzlabojumiem, jauniem tēliem, foršām lietām un satriecošiem piedzīvojumiem kosmosā!

programme.title: Rabla komanda
programme.desc: Pēc sniegota pārsteiguma pienākšanas, Rabla komanda piedāvā palīdzēt Hedlija viesnīcā. Kad kāpnes izrādās nepietiekami ātras, ir laiks celt. Karls adoptē kaķēnus. Kad viņi izraisa popkorna elli, Rabla komanda padara kafejnīcu kaķēniem draudzīgu.

programme.title: Krokodila kungs
programme.desc: Džidži dodas uz putnu SPA, un Krokodila kungs un Deizija pieskata viņas ligzdu. Kamēr Džidži ir prom, viņi nolemj uzrīkot pārsteigumu, iekārtojot viņas ligzdu, lai tā būtu tikpat grezna kā putnu spa. Kad viņa atgriežas, viņa pat neatpazīst savu ligzdu. Lai gan viņa novērtē paveikto, viņai pietrūkst vecās ligzdas un viņa nejūtas kā mājās jaunajā. Grupa uzzina, ka mājām nav jābūt greznām, lai tās būtu īpašas, un cenšas atrast veidu, kā Džidži atkal justos kā mājās!

programme.title: Krokodila kungs
programme.desc: Martins ir uzbūvējis jaunu Bočes laukumu kopienai un rīko turnīru! Deizija un mamma apvienojas ar Krokodila kungu kā treneri, lai kopā pavadītu laiku kā māte ar meitu un krokodils. Taču, konkurencei kļūstot sīvākai, Deizija sāk uztraukties, ka, ja viņas neuzvarēs, viņa pievils mammu. Viņai jāatrod veids, kā nepievilt mammu, bet arī pateikt, kā viņa patiesībā jūtas.

Asupilī nav lielākas zvaigznes par Bleizu. Viņš ir čempions sacīkšu trasē un varonis ārpus tās. Kad vien ir kāda ķibele, visi vēršas pie viņa, jo zina, ka Bleizs spēj to, ko nespēj citas mašīnas. Viņš ir ātrākais automonstrs pilsētā - viņam piemīt bliezienātrums! Liekot lietā savas zināšanas, Bleizs spēj tikt galā ar jebkādu izaicinājumu. Ja situācija kļūst sarežģīta, viņš spēj iztēloties sevi par jebkuru mašīnu, pārvērsties par to un pavisam viegli atrisināt ikvienu problēmu.

programme.title: Ķepu patruļa
programme.desc: "Ķepu patruļa" ir seriāls pirmsskolas vecuma bērniem, kura galvenie varoņi ir seši varonīgi kucēni Čeiss, Māršals, Rokijs, Zuma, Rabls un Skaja, kuru saimnieks ir tehnoloģijas pārzinošais 10 gadus vecais zēns Raiders. Viņiem ir unikālas problēmu risināšanas spējas, stilīgi braucamrīki un daudz kucēniem raksturīga mīļa humora. "Kepu patruļa" dodas bīstamās glābšanas misijās, lai Piedzīvojumu līča iedzīvotāji būtu drošībā. Māršals – suns ugunsdzējs, Čeiss – suns policists, Skaja, kura lido savā helikopterā, un citi – katram kucēnam ir sava īpaša personība un spējas, atspoguļojot kopīga darba un pilsoniskās atbildības nozīmību. Viņiem visiem uz muguras ir īpašas mugursomas, lai viņi būtu spējīgi paveikt visu, sākot no kaķēnu glābšanas līdz vilciena apturēšanai, neļaujot tam nokrist no klints. Lai cik liels būtu piedzīvojums, "Ķepu patruļai" vienmēr atliek laiks spēlēm, jautrībai un tam, lai Raiders pakasa aiz auss. Interesants "Ķepu patruļas" fakts – Raders izglāba visus kucēnus un iemācīja tiem viņu spējas.

programme.title: Rabla komanda

programme.desc: Nē! Nē! Tas nav beidzies! Barbabravo nav mazs, viņš ir liels puika! No šis dienas viņš tā arī dzīvos - nekādu snaudu, uzkodu un spēlēšanās ar brāļiem un māsām. // Barbabērni pirmoreiz dodas uz lielveikalu. Tik daudz preču, lieliska vieta! Bet kāpēc viss satīts plastmasas plēvēs?

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!
programme.desc: Pēkšņi pa nakti pazudušas Barbazū skaistās rozes. Viņš ir drošs, ka vainīga Barbabella. Bet kā lai piedabū viņu atzīties? programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!

programme.title: Rabla komanda
programme.desc: Kad ceļojošā veterinārārste daktere Diva nevar laikā veikt visu Celtnieklīcī dzīvojošo dzīvnieku apskati, Rabla komanda zina, kā jārīkojas. Lilijas nāriņu ballīte tiek atsaukta, kad sāk līt. Laiks celtniecības risinājumam!

programme.title: Rabla komanda
programme.desc: Pēc sniegota pārsteiguma pienākšanas, Rabla komanda piedāvā palīdzēt Hedlija viesnīcā. Kad kāpnes izrādās nepietiekami ātras, ir laiks celt. Karls adoptē kaķēnus. Kad viņi izraisa popkorna elli, Rabla komanda padara kafejnīcu kaķēniem draudzīgu.

programme.title: Sonic Prime
programme.desc: The rebels battle the Chaos Council to secure the "Crystal" that gives the Council supreme power. Sonic assumes this crystal is the Paradox Prism, but he's stunned by the truth about the Power Crystal... and the events that shattered the world.

programme.title: The Marsupilamis
programme.desc: After reading a book by the Twins' parents, Bibi learns about Marsupilamis and decides she wants one. The Twins deny Marsupilamis exist, but Bibi's convinced they have their own, so starts spying on them. Jade claims a tail that Bibi spots is just a hose, but Bibi wants proof. So Mica sends the Marsupilamis to fetch one-they try to steal Rosa's hose but it ends up getting lost, and whilst hunting for it Twister mistakes a Jaguar's tail for the hose. The Jaguar then follows them back home where they manage to trap it in their nest, where Bibi encounters it thinking it's a Marsup! Scared she declares she's sticking to Puppies in the future. // Lunch service at the school canteen is slow and Jade leads a chant to speed up the service. The the chef is offended and quits, and things then get worse as Marcel is hired, and his disgusting food quickly generates resentment towards Jade. With the help of the Marsups the old chef returns, and is so appalled by the food that she reclaims her job.

programme.title: Best and Bester
programme.desc: Best and Bester are a pair of hilariously individual twins who live in a weird and wonderful alternate reality where your neighbour could be a pair of disgruntled trousers or your best friend a floating cloud of bottom burp. But, unlike their friends and neighbours, Best and Bester have the unique ability to choose a new body every single day and, in doing so, experience life in a completely different way.

From Cave Pat to Pat-Tron to Pat The Hapless, Tinkle's presence impacts a world of different Patricks throughout this epic journey through time. // Cecil and Bunny struggle to keep Patrick and Squidina away from the TV on "Spend Time With One Of Your Kids Day". While Bunny takes Patrick shopping, Cecil takes Squidina fishing. Their separate adventures converge at the mall, where the whole family discovers a virtual reality experience.

programme.title: The Patrick Star Show
programme.desc: When Granny Tentacles goes out for a spa day, Patrick volunteers to watch over her house. In a failed attempt to follow Granny's instructions, Patrick makes his way into her home, then brings Squidina inside too. Between breaking Granny's furniture, tearing out her toilet, and letting a wild animal out of its cage, Patrick destroys the entire house, just as Granny returns home to witness it. // Without seeing him, the Star family obliviously smashes up Plankton, leading him to forget who he is. When the injured, amnesic Plankton is saved and adopted by the Dartfish family, it does not take long for him to teach the overly polite family his evil ways. Meanwhile, Karen searches all over town for her missing husband.

programme.title: The Patrick Star Show
programme.desc: After driving her limo over Patrick, a court order forces Lady Upturn to live with the Star family as punishment. Lady Upturn struggles to adapt to the Star lifestyle at first, then learns to appreciate its freedom...maybe too much.

programme.title: Sonic Prime
programme.desc: Sonic lands in the deep seas of The No Place, where pirate versions of his friends are led by Knuckled the Dredd. When Sonic's hunt for the No Place Shard runs afoul of the Dredd's haunted past, the crew names a new captain... Sonic!

programme.title: The Thundermans: Undercover
programme.desc: Still eager to impress Captain Perfect, Max volunteers to help him with his younger sister, a headstrong girl who seems to drawn to evil. Max tries to show her the benefits of being good, but she tricks him and heads to auditions for new Mastermind henchmen. Max disguises himself and goes the auditions, too, hoping to stop her from working for a supervillain. Both he and the young girl are chosen to prove their evil and destroy Splat by Sea, but Max reveals his identity to her and talks her out of being a villain just before the restaurant is ruined. Meanwhile, Phoebe convinces BC he needs an elaborate dance-posal to ask Chloe to the school dance, but her interference does more harm than good.

programme.title: Danger Force
programme.desc: This fun spin-off of Henry Danger is set in the Swellview Academy for the Gifted and follows the adventures of four young friends. Chapa, Miles, Bose and Mika were ordinary kids, until they discovered they have superpowers. They are recruited by Captain Man to become his new crime-fighting crew, and protect the city of Swellview from various villains. But before that Captain Man must teach them how to control their superpowers, as well as to how to work as a team, using Schwoz as his helper.

programme.title: Henry Danger
programme.desc: Henry Danger is a story about adventures of a 13-year-old Henry Hart who is lucky to become a helpmate of a super hero Captain Man. This is a real dream job of every teen. The newbie is getting paid for fighting against crime and helping to save the world. Brave Henry must hide his job from his family and friends and it is not that simple, but nothing can stop him from being a true crime-fighter. Henry himself wants to become a super hero one day, that is why he is constantly learning from Captain Man and is not scared of any hardships on the way to his dream.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: In this crowded and chaotic household, Lincoln Loud is the only boy among his ten sisters. With eleven children under one roof, things get a little bit crazy sometimes, to say the least. This children's cartoon is fun and light-hearted, and Clyde, Lincoln's best friend, only adds to that. Clyde is an only child by contrast, and is jealous of Lincoln's abundance of siblings. Clyde also has a massive crush on Lori, who is Lincoln's oldest sister. However, she has a boyfriend, Bobby. Bobby, although not being particularly intelligent, has several different jobs, ranging from life guard, to security at a shopping centre.
